an4.274:1.1: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā.
an4.274:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
an4.274:1.4: vedanāsu . . . citte . . . dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
an4.274:1.5: Rāgassa bhikkhave abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā
